messages:
Alex P.: Quick heads-up — manager handoff timeline for this review cycle. Final manager edits submitted in the review form are due Thu 2024-04-18 18:00 UTC. We plan to do a batched Workday upload Fri 2024-04-19 09:00 UTC. Please follow the checklist below and sign up for a UTC slot if you need a live handoff. cc @Sara C.

Sara C.: Link to the master checklist + form template: https://go/redwood/review-checklist (view only). Key notes: 1) Use the \`Manager Review Form v3\` (do not mix with older CSVs). 2) Attach evidence for any improvement areas. 3) Flag LOA / transfers in the header.

Sara C.: Quick checklist (paste into your manager notes):
- Confirm reviewer names in the form
- Fill numeric ratings and short rationale (1-2 lines)
- Attach 1 exemplar piece of work for any "Below expectations"
- Mark exceptions with \`EXCEPTION_REASON\` tag

Jason L.: For teams that want to export a CSV of their filled forms before upload, use the admin export in the People Ops portal -> Exports -> "ReviewExports". That CSV maps to our Workday batch columns. If anyone wants a quick script to remap fields, I can share.

Priya M.: Quick Q — contractors and hourly ICs: do they go into the same form or a separate path? We have 3 temps finishing right before deadline.

Tom H.: Contractors: fill the same Manager Review Form but put \`Contractor\` in the role_type field and add contract end date in the notes. We will exclude them from calibration unless manager requests a calibration slot.

Alex P.: Calibration schedule: we have three 90min panels Fri 2024-04-19 at 13:00 UTC, 16:00 UTC, and 20:00 UTC. Please sign up here: https://go/redwood/calibration-signup (pick only one). If your manager load is <5 direct reports, pick the smaller panel (13:00).

Priya M.: Can we get an optional 30min prep slot with People Ops for new managers? I have two new managers.

Sara C.: Yep — added optional 30m prep slots Thu 2024-04-17 14:00 UTC and Thu 2024-04-17 20:00 UTC. Sign up link is same as above (there's a dropdown for prep).

Jason L.: Note to engineering managers: if you want the mapping script, paste your export here and I'll run a one-off transform. I can also add tokenized anonymization if you want to share with L4 reviewers.

Tom H.: Calibration panel lead volunteers: @Alex P., @Tom H., @Sara C. — still need 2 IC leads from eng to join each panel. Priya, can you ask your TLs?

Priya M.: I can cover the 16:00 UTC panel and will loop in Rahul and Mei from my org for the 20:00 slot.

Alex P.: Last-minute hires: if someone joined in the final 2 weeks and didn't have a full probation period, put \`SHORT_TENURE\` in the header and add a 1-line recommendation. We will handle these as exceptions in calibration.

ops-bot: Reminder scheduled: "Manager edits due Thu 2024-04-18 18:00 UTC" posted 2024-04-16 12:00 UTC. Reaction: :alarm_clock:

Sara C.: Sample reminder email you can paste into Slack/email to managers:
```
Subject: Reminder — Manager edits due Thu 18:00 UTC
Hi team — quick reminder to finish your Manager Review Form by Thu 18:00 UTC. Attach evidence for any ratings below expectations and mark exceptions with EXCEPTION_REASON. Workday batch upload Fri 09:00 UTC; no changes after upload. Reach out in #people-ops if you need a handoff slot.
Thanks,
People Ops
```

Jason L.: If anyone hits an import mapping error on Fri during the upload window, ping me directly with a screenshot and I'll roll back and re-run the small-batch path.

Alex P.: Thanks all — I'll post a final checklist tomorrow morning and lock the signup at 11:00 UTC Fri. :raised_hands:
